cohort: The cohort consisted of 465,069 women aged 15-50 years, including 1,705 with first-trimester antidepressant exposure, who delivered their first and singleton child in Hong Kong between 2003 and 2018.
finding: First-trimester antidepressant exposure was not robustly associated with an increased risk of overall major congenital malformations, although some specific associations with cardiac and respiratory anomalies were noted but not consistently affirmed.
